lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 7-8 visible vertical columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with horizontal spot alignments to form anchor points across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-luminance dorsal edges and shadowed ventral edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Elongated, high-luminance feature indicative of a commensal organism (remora) attached to the dorsal region above the anterior-most columns of the flank pattern.
